name: Ham, Egg & Cress Smash
notes:
Cheesy, eggy and packed with protein. Good for keeping in the fridge for quick lunches all week.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 6 eggs
• 30g mature cheddar
• 3 tbsp light mayonnaise
• 10 cornichons
• 200g cress
• 15g fresh chives
• 200g thick-cut ham
• 1 tsp Dijon mustard
• 1 tsp wholegrain mustard
• Salt
• Black pepper
To serve:
• 4 slices sourdough
• Crisps (optional)

Method:
1. Bring a pan of water to the boil, lower in the eggs and simmer for 8 mins. Cool in iced water, then peel. Separate the yolks from the whites and add both to a large mixing bowl.
2. Snip the cress and chives into the bowl with scissors. Grate in the cheddar with a peeler. Add the ham and cornichons, then the mayonnaise, mustards and some salt and pepper.
3. Chop everything through with a pizza cutter until it has an egg salad consistency.
4. Spoon onto freshly toasted bread and top with your favourite crisps and a few extra cornichons.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 4g, fibre 4g, sugars 5g, sodium 1202mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/ham-egg-cress-high-protein-smash
